newsitem.title: USA: Galaxy Foods won't enter China venture.
newsitem.headline: Galaxy Foods won't enter China venture.

text.p: Galaxy Foods Co. said Friday it decided not to enter into a joint venture agreement with Pacific Foods Ltd., a subsidiary of AMPAC International Inc., and Huzhou Zhenyuantong Foods MFY of the People's Republic of China .

Galaxy first reported the proposed joint venture in a press release dated Sept. 24, when it announced the signing of a letter of intent with Pacific Foods and HZ Foods to produce, sell and distribute various food products to consumer markets in the PRC.
